Astroneers stumble through three games; Finklestein calls for a reset

THE FINKLESTEIN REPORT | NOVEMBER 21

The Astroneers went 1–2 with 9 goals for and 14 against on 34 shots to 30. 2 of the 3 games ended in a DNF, so those results are real but the minutes are not. Opposing goalies: 3 human, 0 AI.

TEAM PERFORMANCE
1–2 · Goals 9–14 · Goal differential −5 · Shots 34–30
L 0–3, DNF vs. EA LUCK
L 3–7, DNF vs. PWHL Devils
W 6–4 vs. MangeuxDGraines

PLAYER REPORT CARDS

🐦 Flappy Beef · Night Grade N/A · Astroneers Overall 73
No recorded appearance this night, so there is no grade to hand out.
Next skate: If you are out, tell the group before the first puck drop so we can set the lineup.

💪 Gordy Mappletoes Jr · Night Grade B · Astroneers Overall 71
2 goals and 5 assists in 2 games, with 4 points against MangeuxDGraines. 12 takeaways, 9 giveaways (4.5 a game; the 3v3 defender average is 5.5), 2 blocks. The puck care is acceptable. The next level is more takeaways than giveaways.
Next skate: Keep one skater above the play and take the simple first pass.
🎙️ “7 points is fine. 9 giveaways is a meeting.”

🥅 Gumbo Slice Jr · Night Grade D · Astroneers Overall 64
18 saves on 29 shots (62.1%) in 2 games. The human 3v3 goalie average is 70.4%, so that is below par.
Next skate: Pick the goal you would most like back and tell us what you saw. Then we go again.
🎙️ “Sixty-something percent is not our number. Settle in. Same time tomorrow.”

🫎 Moose McBroom II · Night Grade B · Astroneers Overall 83
5 goals and 4 assists in 2 games, with 6 points against MangeuxDGraines. 9 takeaways, 23 giveaways (11.5 a game; the 3v3 center average is 6.5). The giveaways are the topic, especially 14 against PWHL Devils.
Next skate: Keep one skater above the play and take the simple first pass.
🎙️ “9 points is fine. 23 giveaways is a meeting.”

🌟 THREE STARS
1. Gordy — Night Grade B, 7 points.
2. Moose — Night Grade B, 9 points.
3. Gumbo — Night Grade D, 18/29 saves.

🎯 THE NEXT SKATE
Give the puck carrier a short outlet and cut the giveaways, finish every game we start, confirm the lineup before puck drop.

Astroneers drop three straight after fast start; Finklestein calls out missing starter

THE FINKLESTEIN REPORT | NOVEMBER 20

The Astroneers opened with two wins and 11 goals, then lost three straight to finish 2–3. Coach Finklestein had plenty to say about turnovers and put starting goalie Gumbo Slice Jr on notice about lineup availability after five games with no recorded appearance.

TEAM PERFORMANCE
2–3 · Goals 16–18 · Goal differential −2 · Shots 87–88
W 4–2 vs. Twin Cities Sinners
W 7–3 vs. Bow To The Meow
L 3–4 vs. Stanky Beevas
L 0–2 vs. Honkers Inc
L 2–7, DNF vs. DropTheGloves

Stanky Beevas started the slide with a one-goal win. Honkers shut out the Astroneers on 14 shots, and the finale against DropTheGloves ended in a DNF. The Astroneers scored 11 goals in their two wins and five in their three losses.

PLAYER REPORT CARDS

🫎 Moose McBroom II · Night Grade D · Astroneers Overall 88
Led the club with 7 goals and 5 assists in five games. Put up five points and recorded 19 giveaways against Bow To The Meow.
Next skate: Find the short outlet before the puck gets to you. Use it when the lane closes, then move for the return pass.
🎙️ “Five points gets you in the paper. Nineteen giveaways gets you in my office. Busy morning, Moose.”

🐦 Flappy Beef · Night Grade D · Astroneers Overall 79
Finished with 5 goals and 3 assists and had a point on all four goals against Twin Cities. Recorded 12 giveaways in the one-goal loss to Stanky Beevas.
Next skate: Give the puck carrier a close option. Pass, move, and show your stick again.
🎙️ “I’m putting the Twin Cities game on first. Four points. We’ll let that guy explain the next tape.”

💪 Gordy Mappletoes Jr · Night Grade D · Astroneers Overall 74
Put up 4 goals and 4 assists in four games, including a hat trick and three assists against Bow To The Meow. Recorded 12 giveaways against Honkers.
Next skate: Simplify the first pass and stay available behind the forwards until somebody rotates back.
🎙️ “Six points from defense. Excellent. Against Honkers, you gave me 12 reasons to spend practice on the first pass.”

🥅 Gumbo Slice Jr · Night Grade N/A · Astroneers Overall 66
Five games. Zero recorded appearances from the starting goalie. With no verified goalie line, there was no performance grade to hand out.
🎙️ “Gumbo, a starting job comes with a very demanding first step. Show up. We dropped the puck five times. If you’re out, say so before Game 1. I’m done putting ‘maybe’ on the lineup card.”
Next skate: Confirm before puck drop. If you’re unavailable, give the club enough notice to name a backup.

🌟 THREE STARS
1. Gordy — six points from defense in the 7–3 win.
2. Moose — a team-leading 12 points across five games.
3. Flappy — a point on every Astroneers goal against Twin Cities.
🎙️ “Three stars, three D’s. Enjoy the stars. Bring the report cards to practice.”

🎯 THE NEXT SKATE
Confirm the lineup before Game 1, give the puck carrier a short outlet, and keep one skater behind the play when both forwards go up ice.
